newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher on fresh commitment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher on fresh commitment.

text.p: Dhaka stocks maintained their rally ahead of Sunday's public holiday as the current uptrend lured punters into making fresh commitments, brokers said.

The benchmark Dhaka Stock Exchange index closed 44.88 points or 3.92 percent higher at 1,189.46. Gainers led the losers by 97 to 26. Turnover rose to 87.6 million taka from the previous session's 79.4 million.
Brokers said shares with sound fundamentals continued to draw both retailers and institutions.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co Ltd rose 9.90 taka to 160.35 and Beximco Pharma gained 9.47 to 171.
